report_name: 19 Flaws in Industrial Gateway Grant Root Access to OT Networks

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: An authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-27546) in the device's web server allows an attacker to obtain a valid administrator session without credentials by manipulating the initial password setup mechanism.

attack_patterns.name: Command-Line Interface
attack_patterns.description: Post-authentication command injection vulnerabilities (e.g., CVE-2026-27549, CVE-2026-27559) in the web interface allow for the execution of arbitrary OS commands on the device, leading to root-level control.

attack_patterns.name: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
attack_patterns.description: Chaining the authentication bypass vulnerability with command injection flaws allows an attacker to gain complete root-level control of the Pepperl+Fuchs IO-Link Master device.

attack_patterns.name: Manipulation of View
attack_patterns.description: A compromised IO-Link Master could be used to alter data sent from sensors to the PLC, causing the control system to make incorrect decisions based on false information.

attack_patterns.name: Manipulation of Control
attack_patterns.description: An attacker with control of the IO-Link Master could send malicious commands to actuators, causing physical equipment like valves or motors to operate in an unsafe or destructive manner.

attack_patterns.name: Remote Services
attack_patterns.description: With root access on the gateway, an attacker can use the compromised device as a launchpad to attack other sensitive devices on the OT network, such as PLCs and HMIs.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-27546
vulnerabilities.description: A critical authentication bypass vulnerability in the device's web server allows an attacker to bypass credential checks and obtain a valid administrator session by manipulating the initial password setup mechanism.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-27549
vulnerabilities.description: A post-authentication command injection vulnerability that can be exploited after gaining an authenticated session to execute arbitrary OS commands with root privileges.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-27559
vulnerabilities.description: A post-authentication command injection vulnerability that can be exploited after gaining an authenticated session to execute arbitrary OS commands with root privileges.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-27557
vulnerabilities.description: One of 19 vulnerabilities disclosed, contributing to an attacker's ability to perform reconnaissance and manipulation of the device. Specifics include path traversal, information disclosure, or incorrect authorization.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-27564
vulnerabilities.description: One of 19 vulnerabilities disclosed, contributing to an attacker's ability to perform reconnaissance and manipulation of the device. Specifics include path traversal, information disclosure, or incorrect authorization.

identities.name: Nozomi Networks
identities.description: Security research firm that discovered and disclosed the 19 vulnerabilities in the Pepperl+Fuchs IO-Link Master.

identities.name: Pepperl+Fuchs
identities.description: Vendor of the IO-Link Master industrial gateway, which was found to have 19 vulnerabilities. The company has released patched firmware.

identities.name: CERT@VDE
identities.description: Coordinated the disclosure of the vulnerabilities with Pepperl+Fuchs.

indicators.name: IO-Link Master Initial Setup Page Access Attempt
indicators.pattern:
title: IO-Link Master Initial Setup Page Access Attempt
id: 2a9b4c1d-8e7f-4a3b-9c8d-1e2f3a4b5c6d
status: experimental
description: >
  Detects suspicious requests to web server setup pages on a Pepperl+Fuchs IO-Link Master device that is already configured. This could indicate an attempt to exploit CVE-2026-27546 for authentication bypass.
references:
  - https://www.nozominetworks.com/blog/fooling-the-master-pepperl-fuchs-io-link-under-attack
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-29
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: high
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    cs-host|contains: 'io-link-master'
    c-uri-stem|contains:
      - '/password_setup.php'
      - '/initial_config.html'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects attempts to access initial password setup functions on a device that is already configured, which could be an attempt to exploit the authentication bypass (CVE-2026-27546).

indicators.name: Shell Execution on IO-Link Master
indicators.pattern:
title: Shell Execution on IO-Link Master
id: 3b8a5d2e-9f6e-4b2c-8d7c-2f1e0a9b8c7d
status: experimental
description: >
  Detects the execution of a shell (sh) on a Pepperl+Fuchs IO-Link Master device. This may indicate successful command injection (e.g., via CVE-2026-27549) and compromise of the device.
references:
  - https://www.nozominetworks.com/blog/fooling-the-master-pepperl-fuchs-io-link-under-attack
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-29
tags:
  - attack.t0818
level: critical
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '/sh'
    ParentImage|endswith: 
      - '/httpd'
      - '/boa'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of a shell process ('sh') on the device, which could indicate successful command injection after exploiting a vulnerability like CVE-2026-27549.
